mainEntity.name: What are the railing options for a redwood deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: For redwood decks, railing options include traditional redwood pickets, glass panels, cable railings, or metal balusters, each offering a distinct aesthetic and level of visibility. Choosing the right railing is a practical tradeoff between desired view, safety needs, maintenance, and overall design style. For instance, cable railings offer an unobstructed view, while solid redwood provides more privacy.
